verdict.rationale: Bolt has a dedicated tokens documentation page. It explains that direct edits in Code view do not consume tokens and that extra tokens can be purchased, so the product documents its token model to some degree. Community reports confirm users hit free-token limits, but the evidence does not show per-action token costs or what each plan includes. Missing for 10: per-action token consumption breakdown, plan-by-plan inclusions and limits, a usage dashboard or meter, independent corroboration of how clear the pricing is.

support.subject: As a founder, I can understand what credits or tokens each action consumes and what my plan includes
